first_development_run: archived; source changed during execution so bilingual identity assertion stopped run; final jobs regenerated with fixed source
adaptations_after_inspection: Added image confirmation of named gourd body shape after inspecting flask counterexample.
Made double/triple gourd inherit generic gourd conditions after observing non-nested result sets.
Fixed Dish/Box singular recognition and added water coupe/brush washer category conflicts after seeing red-bowl false inclusions.
Require positive blue-white probe and negative counter probe; the learned score alone had admitted a polychrome dish despite negative direct evidence.
Added conservative 0.35 outer-rim/body ratio and a symmetric mouth-axis body measure after inspecting wide mouths and an asymmetric background-mask extension.
known_tradeoff: The body check removes the flat-flask counterexample but also rejects several museum-labelled gourd variants. These are retained as misses, not relabelled as negatives.
label_scope: Assistant photo and catalogue diagnostic review after predictions; not blind human test data.
strict_mouth_policy: Image proxy <= 0.35 plus semantic visible-opening checks; engineering threshold, not independently calibrated physical measurement.
